title: Sacred Minimalism and Existential Reductio in Pilinszky's Essays

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: The text presents János Pilinszky's essay collection *Szög és olaj* (Nail and Oil) as a monument of spiritual reduction. It says that after the catastrophes of the twentieth century (the camps) talkative rhetoric lost its force, and that writing must stand wordless (*szótlan*) before the mystery of suffering and grace (*kegyelem*).

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: The text says his prose is stripped of adjectives. A sample sentence in that spirit (not a quotation): *A művészet nem önkifejezés, hanem önfeladás: a csend megnyitása a kegyelem előtt.*

sections.title: Patterns in Context
rows: The power of radical spiritual minimalism...
